name: Hurrikan
description: Hurrikan (Hurricane) is a German fishing card game closely related to the Italian classic 'Scopa' and its Spanish cousin 'Escoba'. Players capture cards from a central layout by matching values from their hand. The game is named for the 'Hurrikan' move (a 'Sweep'), where a player captures all cards from the table in a single turn.

history.origins: A regional adaptation of 'Scopa' that migrated to Germany. It preserves the core capturing mechanics but uses standard or German-suited cards and a specific point-target of 16.
timeline: 19th Century: Variations of Scopa spread through trade routes into Central Europe.
Early 20th Century: 'Hurrikan' rules appear in German game books as a popular parlor game.
Present: Remains a common variant in Southern Germany and parts of the former Austro-Hungarian empire.
history.cultural: Symbolizes the 'Sweep' (Hurrikan) as a dramatic tactical high-point.
history.evolution: The game simplifies the complex 'Primiera' scoring of Scopa into a more straightforward 'Most Hearts' and 'Seven of Hearts' focus.

setup.deck: Usually 32-40 cards. If using 52, remove 8s, 9s, 10s. Ranking: Ace (1), 2-7 (Face), Jack (8), Queen (9), King (10).
setup.dealing: Deal 3 cards to each player and 4 face-up on the table.

rules.objective: Score 16 points by capturing cards and completing 'Hurrikans'.
rules.gameplay: 1. On your turn, play one card from your hand. 2. Capture: If your card matches a card on the table, you take both. If your card matches the SUM of multiple cards on the table, you take all of them. 3. Priority: You MUST capture a single card of equal value before combining cards. 4. The Hurrikan (Sweep): If your capture leaves the table empty, you score 1 bonus point. 5. If you cannot capture, you must add your card to the table.
keyRules: You MUST capture a single card of equal value before combining cards
The Hurrikan (Sweep): capturing all cards from the table scores 1 bonus point
Scoring: Most cards (1 pt), Most Hearts (1 pt), Seven of Hearts (1 pt), Each Hurrikan (1 pt)
First to 16 points wins the match

strategy.basic: Prioritize capturing Heart cards and the Seven of Hearts above all else. Try to leave your opponent with no combinations that sum to 10 (the maximum face card value).
strategy.intermediate: Denial: If you see the table has a 3, a 4, and an Ace (Sum = 8), and you don't have an 8, avoid playing a card that would make the total sum to a Jack, Queen, or King.
strategy.advanced: Counting 7s: The Sevens are the most powerful cards for building combinations. If you know three 7s are gone, you can safely play high cards without fearing a Hurrikan.
tips: Save your '10' (King) for when the board has many low cards that sum to 10.
Never leave a single card on the table if you can help it, as it's an easy setup for an opponent's Hurrikan.
